code.name: IS 13932 (cyclone-resistant buildings) + IS 4352/IS 1893 (earthquake) - National Building Code of India
code.notes: Wind speeds per IS 875-3 basic wind map; coastal Bay-of-Bengal districts require cyclone-resilient detailing.

structural_system: lightweight steel/timber frame, continuous load path to anchors

strategies.sanitation: ventilated improved pit (VIP) or composting toilet; never discharge into flood zone

recommendations.measure: Continuous tie-down load path; hurricane clips; impact-resistant glazing
Raise finished floor >= 0.5 m above modelled design flood level, or select alternate parcel
recommendations.reason: Flood susceptibility 0.62; code expects protection for a 50-year return period event

recommendations.measure: Cool-roof (SRI>=78), external shading, night-purge ventilation; target indoor <=35C during heat alert
recommendations.reason: Heatwave susceptibility 0.94. Aligns with WHO shelter guidance and EPBD-style nearly-zero-energy intent where applicable

recommendations.measure: Step-free entrance, 900 mm door clear width, accessible WASH cubicle
recommendations.reason: Mandatory under 'IS 13932 (cyclone-resistant buildings) + IS 4352/IS 1893 (earthquake) - National Building Code of India' accessibility provisions

recommendations.measure: ventilated improved pit (VIP) or composting toilet; never discharge into flood zone
recommendations.reason: Sphere Standards WASH minimum requirements (20 L/person/day, 4.6 m2 shelter/person); flood/drought aware placement

recommendations.measure: Roof-mounted PV >= 200 W/person-served-day with battery; supports cooling and comms
recommendations.reason: High irradiance at this latitude; Sphere + IASC mental-health guidance on lighting and charging facilities

compliance_checks.detail: modelled demand ~0.07 g vs required >= 0.24 g

compliance_checks.check: floor elevation above water proximity threshold
compliance_checks.detail: elevation 0.0 m, distance to water 5000.0 m

compliance_checks.check: soil bearing adequate for chosen system
